3 Let’s Try some Math

Here is an inline equation: x2+3⁢x+7=10. Here is the same equation displayed:

x2+3⁢x+7=10.

Then we can use a stacked equation to show solving this:

x2+3⁢x+7=10 ⇒x2+3⁢x=3 (1)
⇒x2+3⁢x+94=5⁤14 (2)
⇒(x+32)2=±5⁤14 (3)
⇒x=−32±5⁤14. (4)

What if we use special symbols like ℕ or 𝔑? Yes, both of those worked well. What about 𝒫 and 2/3 and ✗? Yep, that worked too.
